facts.fact: The Cabinet Thomas Dingamgoto analysis applies Loi n°007/PR/2015 to personal data, including transfers abroad under articles 29 to 32.
ACTPOL, citing the African Union status list of 2 February 2026, says Chad has signed the Malabo Convention without ratifying it.
At a 30 September to 1 October 2026 workshop, participants reviewed Chad's personal data protection law, and ACSIS-Tchad said existing laws are not applied.
ACSIS-Tchad's representative said Chad was among the first African countries to ratify the Malabo Convention.
